Try providing different username.") hashed_password = pwd_context.hash(request.password) cursor.execute("INSERT INTO users (user_name, password) VALUES (?, ?)", (request.user_name, hashed_password)) conn.commit() conn.close() return {"message": "User created successfully."} if __name__ == "__main__": import uvicorn uvicorn.run(app, host="0.0.0.0", port=5000)
